attempts.sql: WITH cg AS (SELECT symbol_id, file_id FROM code.symbols WHERE name = 'create_graph' AND file_id = 'auto_ontology/retrieval/text_to_sql/text_to_sql_graph.py'), args AS (SELECT c.caller_symbol_id, c.callee_symbol_id, c.callee_name, c.line FROM code.calls c JOIN cg ON c.caller_symbol_id = cg.symbol_id WHERE c.call_kind = 'argument' OR c.resolution = 'argument'), resolved AS (SELECT DISTINCT a.callee_symbol_id AS symbol_id FROM args a WHERE a.callee_symbol_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT DISTINCT s.symbol_id FROM code.symbols s JOIN resolved r ON s.symbol_id = r.symbol_id ORDER BY s.symbol_id

request:
When the text-to-SQL LangGraph is assembled by create_graph in auto_ontology/retrieval/text_to_sql/text_to_sql_graph.py, which functions or methods of this repository does create_graph hand over by reference, i.e. pass the function object itself as an argument to another call (as with graph.add_conditional_edges(node, router_fn, ...)) rather than calling it? Count only plain names passed directly as call arguments; functions that create_graph calls itself, values that are the result of a call (such as _make_soft_check_router(...)), lambdas, and local variables holding nodes do not count. Functions passed only inside an if/else branch of create_graph count. Return each distinct function's symbol ID.

Requested output columns: symbol_id (string).
explanation: This query finds the create_graph symbol in the text_to_sql_graph.py file, then looks at calls made by create_graph that are argument-passing references (call_kind/resolution indicating an argument), and returns the distinct symbol IDs of the functions passed by reference.
sql: WITH cg AS (SELECT symbol_id, file_id FROM code.symbols WHERE name = 'create_graph' AND file_id = 'auto_ontology/retrieval/text_to_sql/text_to_sql_graph.py'), args AS (SELECT c.caller_symbol_id, c.callee_symbol_id, c.callee_name, c.line FROM code.calls c JOIN cg ON c.caller_symbol_id = cg.symbol_id WHERE c.call_kind = 'argument' OR c.resolution = 'argument'), resolved AS (SELECT DISTINCT a.callee_symbol_id AS symbol_id FROM args a WHERE a.callee_symbol_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT DISTINCT s.symbol_id FROM code.symbols s JOIN resolved r ON s.symbol_id = r.symbol_id ORDER BY s.symbol_id
